parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

- **manual** (default): The rule is manually created.

- **clover**: The rule is automatically generated.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
